# MSTR — OPEN OPTION POSITION

- Position: one Sep. 11 $125/$135 bull call debit spread after a 50% target trim
- Open orders: none
- Original order: `81fa7e82-6798-47a1-86b4-e41af3f31692`, client ID `alpaca-stage2-20260902-MSTR-option-buy`, status `replaced`, filled 0/2

- Leg fills: long `MSTR260911C00125000` 2 at $4.10; short `MSTR260911C00135000` 2 at $1.48
- Fill time: `2026-09-02T16:48:46.446501335Z`
- Target-trim order: `3e31adb7-2eea-4569-8469-3e391b737c19`, client ID `alpaca-stage2-20260903-MSTR-option-sell`, filled 1/1 at a $6.90 net credit
- Target-trim leg fills: long $125 call sold at $16.00; short $135 call covered at $9.10 at `2026-09-03T16:35:33.782484589Z`
- Current contracts: long 1 `MSTR260911C00125000`; short 1 `MSTR260911C00135000`
- Latest Alpaca marks: long call $12.70, market value $1,270, unrealized P/L +$860; short call $5.95, market value -$595, unrealized P/L -$447; retained spread value $675 and unrealized P/L +$413
- Realized gross profit from target trim: +$428; combined package P/L at broker marks: +$841
- Reconciled: 2026-09-08 17:22 Europe/Amsterdam

## Current plan

- Thesis: the bullish daily trend remains intact, with immediate underlying support at $135.47-$137 and resistance at $144.40-$144.92/$149.80-$150.
- Confidence: moderate.
- Holding period: retained runner through 2026-09-09; avoid expiration/assignment without a fresh decision.
- Tactical invalidation: underlying below $135.47, with stronger failure below $129.50; original structural invalidation remains $117.50.
- Size rationale: one spread was closed after the $137.50-$139.80 target zone was reached. Its $690 proceeds exceed the original $524 aggregate debit, locking at least $166 gross package profit even if the retained spread expires worthless.
- Stock decision: no stock order because uncapped crypto-gap exposure is inferior to the existing defined-risk structure.
- Option decision: HOLD one runner for one more session; mandatory close/roll decision on 2026-09-09, before Sep. 11 expiry/assignment risk dominates. Take profit into $144.40-$144.92 or an $8.50+ executable credit; no add.

## History

### 2026-09-02

- Submitted two Sep. 11 $125/$135 spreads at $2.60; 0/2 filled.
- Replaced once at $2.66 after a complete quote/account/order refresh. Replacement was later confirmed `filled`, 2/2 at $2.62 net, with the original order `replaced` 0/2. No further replacement or chase was allowed.

### 2026-09-02 management review

- Fresh MSTR stock quote at `2026-09-02T19:21:25.504541968Z`: bid $122.36 / ask $129.72, 100/100 displayed; this remains unscorably wide for stock execution.
- Fresh option quotes at `2026-09-02T19:21:39Z`–`19:21:40Z`: long $125 call $3.78/$4.11, IV 66.01%, delta 0.4422, theta -0.2831; short $135 call $1.48/$1.52, IV 70.94%, delta 0.2060, theta -0.2181. Conservative executable spread mark is $2.26, approximately -$72 versus the $2.62 actual debit for two spreads.
- HOLD remains warranted: the underlying bid is above the $117.50 invalidation and inside the researched $120–$122.50 demand area; the vertical preserves a defined maximum loss despite 24/7 Bitcoin risk. Current news notes Strategy resumed Bitcoin purchases but also highlights the continuing crypto-linked volatility; see [The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-09-02-strategy-ceo-says-selling-bitcoin-at-60000-before-buying-at-80000-was-the-right-trade-413323).
- Account refresh at 2026-09-02 21:58 Europe/Amsterdam: Alpaca marked the option legs at $4.10/$1.65; no new decision or order was made outside the management window.

### 2026-09-03 target review

- MSTR traded through the $137.50-$139.80 second target zone. A fresh focused chain showed an executable closing credit above $6.70 with both contracts active and tradable.
- One spread closed atomically for a $6.90 credit, realizing $428 gross profit. One spread remains; at final broker marks it was worth $690 with +$428 unrealized P/L.
- HOLD the runner toward $148-$150 through the 2026-09-09 review, subject to the original $117.50 underlying invalidation and a fresh assignment/expiration decision before Sep. 11.

### 2026-09-03 management review

- Fresh IEX underlying quote at 15:17 ET was $142.16 bid / $142.26 ask, above the $117.50 invalidation and below the $148-$150 extension. Indicative option quotes were $17.91/$18.66 for the long $125 call and $10.12/$10.42 for the short $135 call. HOLD one runner; the prior one-spread trim already reduced overnight crypto-gap risk, and no further add or chase is allowed. No option order.

### 2026-09-04 premarket management review

- Alpaca confirmed one retained Sep. 11 $125/$135 spread and no open order. Broker marks were $20.35/$12.75; the prior close's conservative indicative executable value was $7.45, with MSTR closing at $144.85 below the $148-$150 runner target.
- Stock HOLD/no order because uncapped crypto-gap exposure remains inappropriate. Option HOLD the defined-risk runner above $117.50 and below $148-$150; reassess after the employment report and before the Sep. 9 review/expiry-management deadline.

### 2026-09-04 post-payroll review

- The retained spread was worth about $695 at broker marks with MSTR near $140, below the $148-$150 extension and above the $117.50 invalidation. HOLD one runner; no stock or option add.

### 2026-09-08 expiry review

- Alpaca confirmed the retained spread at a $675 broker mark; fresh indicative executable sides were about $7.06. Fresh technical research remained bullish while the underlying held $135.47-$137.
- HOLD for one more session because the defined-risk spread has positive net theta while both legs are in the money. No add. A mandatory close/roll decision is due 2026-09-09; do not carry into assignment risk without a fresh decision.

### 2026-09-09 full exit

- Fresh [`technical`](../research/2026-09-09/164416-MSTR-technical.md) and [`fundamental`](../research/2026-09-09/180112-MSTR-fundamental.md) research both favored closing the Sep. 11 runner instead of holding or rolling because front-week momentum had turned choppy and pin/assignment risk near $135 outweighed two more sessions of capped upside.
- Multi-leg order `7bc99118-4b22-42f8-94eb-3e7902a50527` filled the final $125/$135 close at a $6.35 credit: $125 call sold at $9.95, $135 call covered at $3.60. Gross realized profit was approximately $373 on this spread and $801 across the two-spread campaign before fees.
- Status: CLOSED. No MSTR stock or option position and no open order remain. New comparison set: [`../ghost-trades/2026-09-09/alpaca-stage2-20260909-MSTR-option-sell.md`](../ghost-trades/2026-09-09/alpaca-stage2-20260909-MSTR-option-sell.md).
